title: Infostealer high-confidence credential access and exfiltration
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: High-confidence detection of infostealer activity combining suspicious LOLBIN execution, browser credential store access, and network exfiltration. Single-rule fallback for environments without correlation capability; use the three-stage correlated rules in Infostealer_STRICT_Correlated for better precision.
